body:
GREG, 2026-11-07, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e). Verbatim:
- #487 (00:54Z, URGENT): „USUNAC TESTY sprawdzajace claud.md czy agents.md Natychmiast!! Nigdy ich niedodawac”.
- #490 (00:57Z): „Zero tautologi. Tak marnujemy cykle. Te testy nic nie wnosza. Teraz kazda zmiana wymusza zmiane testow. Czyli edycja 2 razy. O ile zlapiemy to odrazu. Absurd! Nigdy wiecej.”
Asistant's scope notes (interpretation, not Greg's verbatim words):
- #487: covers tests that check or pin AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md content in all of the team's projects; keep the files.
- #489: also covers the automatic AGENTS/CLAUDE byte-identity gate; remove it and its gate requirement.
- #490: applies more widely; don't write tests that only pin text or mirror the implementation and force a double edit without verifying behavior; write meaningful tests of observable effects where needed; add no new automatic wording gates.
RULE FOR EVERY AGENT: never add such tests or checks; when reviewing, flag them.
Execution: Engram had no instruction-file tests. w-a577d36eba5c (Merger) removes the identity gate from the standing approval, Required Quality Gates, review-changes.md, the engram-repo SKILL.md and docs/development.md, and adds the ban; exact wording in target/w-a577/wording.md rev 2. Governed text: needs Fable2's concurrence, wording sent to Greg (#491), and Fable's final-diff audit. TermAl: w-7dafeeae3cfe (Opus3) deletes 7 pins.
